name: AI Deep Dive — SEI — 2026-05-02
rationale: Solaris Energy Infrastructure (SEI) has surged 219% over the past year, riding the data center power narrative. While top-line growth is explosive (55%), the company burned -$437M in free cash flow to achieve it. At $72.33, the stock trades at 27x forward earnings, pricing in significant operational success. My weighted fair value of $67.81 suggests the stock is currently fairly valued, balancing the massive growth potential of its Power Solutions segment against the harsh reality of capital intensity and inevitable shareholder dilution.

aiThesis.rationale: SEI (formerly Solaris Oilfield Infrastructure) is executing a fascinating pivot, leveraging its logistics and equipment expertise to provide modular power solutions for data centers. The growth trajectory is undeniable (55% YoY revenue growth), but the economics of this transition are capital-heavy. The company burned $437M in FCF last year. To fund this rapid expansion, I model a 15% shareholder dilution in the base case. At 27x forward P/E, the market is pricing in a successful pivot. The base case present value of $51.75 suggests the stock is slightly overvalued today, but the massive upside potential in the bull case pulls the weighted fair value to $67.81, making it a solid HOLD.
